text: ← All problemsTwo nested power-mean inequalities for the logarithm–arctangent meanFor $a,b>0$, define $M(a,a)=a$ and, when $a\ne b$, $M(a,b)=\frac{b-a}{\sqrt2\,\arctan((\log b-\log a)/\sqrt2)}.$ For $r\ne0$ let $B_r(a,b)=((a^r+b^r)/2)^{1/r}$. Put $d=\sqrt{17}$, $\alpha=(5+d)/2$, and $\beta=(5-d)/2$. Displayed inequalities in Conjecture 37. For all distinct positive $a,b$, do both inequalities hold? $M(a,b)<B_d\!\left(M(a,B_\beta(a,b)),M(B_\beta(a,b),b)\right),$ $M(a,b)<B_{-d}\!\left(M(a,B_\alpha(a,b)),M(B_\alpha(a,b),b)\right).$ This is the two-branch displayed claim of Mihoković–Raïssouli, published Conjecture 37 (earlier arXiv Conjecture 4.7), with their mean $M_2$. The diagonal gives equality. The separate between-means condition used in the source's terminology “super-stabilizable” is not included in this record.ReferencesL. Mihoković and M.
